wins.text: Full-year EPS of $51.32, up 27% YoY; ROE of 15% and ROTE of 16%, improving 230 and 250 bps respectively vs. 2024
GBM produced record full-year revenues of $41.5 billion, up 18% YoY; total equities net revenues hit a record $16.5 billion, surpassing prior year's record by over $3 billion
Record alternatives fundraising of $115 billion for the year; alternatives management and other fees grew to a record $2.4 billion; record management and other fees of $3.1 billion in Q4, up 10% YoY
FICC and equity financing revenues grew to a record $11.4 billion for the year at a 17% CAGR since 2021, comprising 37% of total FICC and equity revenues

Returned ~$4.2 billion to shareholders in Q4 including $3 billion in buybacks; announced $0.50 increase in quarterly dividend to $4.50, a 50% increase from a year ago; $32 billion remaining buyback capacity

risks.text: NIM compression expected in private banking and lending in 2026 as rate cycle continues; CFO flagged this as a headwind to the private banking and lending revenue line
Apple Card portfolio transition creates a small pretax loss expected in Platform Solutions for 2026; $2.3 billion revenue reduction partially offset by $2.5 billion reserve release
AWM pretax margin of 25% and segment ROE of 12.5% in 2025 remain below newly raised targets of 30% margin and high-teen returns, indicating execution risk on the path to new targets
Geopolitical developments, policy uncertainty and macro volatility flagged by CFO as factors that could quickly shift the operating environment and dampen M&A/capital markets activity
IPO market volumes remain decidedly below long-term averages; equity capital markets activity still meaningfully below 2021 peak levels with SPAC-driven volumes not expected to recur

guidance_items.detail: AWM pretax margin target raised to 30% (from prior target), expected to drive high-teen returns in AWM over the medium term

Alternatives fee-paying AUS target set at $750 billion by 2030; annual fundraising target raised to $75-$100 billion sustainably; $1 billion annual incentive fee target reaffirmed with progress expected in 2026
New wealth management long-term fee-based net inflow target introduced at 5% annually
Tax rate guided to approximately 20% for 2026, down slightly from 21.4% in 2025
Platform Solutions expected to generate a small pretax loss for 2026 due to Apple Card transition accounting impact

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Operating leverage and efficiency ratio trajectory — analysts pressed on why Q4 year-over-year efficiency ratio appeared to deteriorate even adjusting for Apple Card
Tokenization, stablecoins, and prediction markets as emerging market structure opportunities — not mentioned proactively by management
Quantification of regulatory cost burden relief and how much expense capacity could be redeployed to growth
